This is NOT a request for competitive proposals and is published for informational purposes only; however, all responsible sources must submit a capability statement, which shall be considered by the Government

Moody AFB is looking for a CMBRE Power Source. Please see below for item description.

For Input Power

Voltage: 208VAC

Frequency: Between 47-63Hz

Phase: 3 Phase

For Output Power

Voltage:115/200V 115VL-N, per MIL-STD-704E

Frequency: 400Hz

Amps: 15 amps per phase to operate

Power Rating: 6.0kVA

Phase: 3 Phase            

For Performance,

Control Interface: Limited Feature Set: RS232, GPIB. (USB, LAN, SD Card, and Video are disabled)

Inrush Current: Includes a "Soft Start" slow turn-on circuit to limit inrush current.

Standards: Converts power to meet MIL-STD-704E nominal values.

For Physical,

Model: 360LSXM/M23004

Connectors: Input: Hubbel Bryant model 72130NP. Output: FSL4-FR type female receptacle.

Enclosure Type: Housed in a double-lid composite transit case with slide rails.            

All questions or comments related to this Sources Sought shall be directed to the Contract Specialist, Kevin Goris at kevin.goris@us.af.mil
